name: Tooyama Kaori
source:
Yukari's brother's wife. She's a classmate of Yukari's who married her brother Koji.

She's the complete opposite of Yukari—a flashy, outgoing older sister type.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/okusama/chara.html]official site[/url]]
